audit_updates.description: Published Tanwir 109:2 English gloss found in Guezzou's publisher-hosted full PDF page 786 (printed p. 774), semantically aligned with Arabic W08 idol gloss. Three original claims I01,I02,I07 already separately imported with linked evidence and voice chains; other claims not verified imported. No bulk staging import or website display asserted.

W08 was imported repeat-safely as proposition 47582 under live Tanwir English entry 29984. Database readback verified one voice chain (reporting work 56) and one evidence link (unit 522), with disputed Ibn Abbas attribution explicit. Production Tafsir UI visibly renders the underlying Tanwir 109:2 gloss; no proposition-specific public rendering was located.

S01-S04 from the original 51-claim staging set and newly audited S05 were imported repeat-safely as propositions 47585-47589. Live Arabic entries resolved to 36289, 36290, 36291, and 36314; evidence units 524-528 and reporting-work 55 voice links passed postflight readback. The repeated 109:3/109:5 explanatory block is stored once under entry 36291; no independent 109:4 explanatory claim was created.

I03-I06 and I08 were imported as propositions 47592-47596 after exact live Arabic anchor and duplicate checks. Entries resolved to 48463, 48465, and 48460; evidence units 530-534 and reporting-work 2 voice links passed readback. Unnamed alternatives use unattributed_group; Ibn Taymiyya remains a named earlier voice. I09-I12 were excluded because the live 109:6 row did not pass the exact I09 anchor check.

T01-T07 were imported as propositions 47597-47603 after exact live Arabic identity, anchor, and duplicate checks. Entries 5264, 5265, and 5274; evidence 535-541; reporting-work 1 voice links all passed postflight readback. Exegete-own, Ibn Abbas/Ibn Zayd named-earlier, unnamed-authority, and unattributed occasion voices remain distinct. No claims were attached to AI-assisted English entries 56199-56204.

Q01-Q12 were imported as source-language-verified propositions 47615-47626 after exact Arabic entry, anchor, and duplicate checks. Entries 13292, 15056, 17630, 17631; evidence 552-563; reporting-work 3 voice links passed postflight readback. Competing and attributed voices remain distinct. This does not resolve the stored Qurtubi English truncation.

W01-W07 were imported as propositions 47627-47633 after live English identity, edition-aligned semantic marker, and duplicate checks. Entries 29983, 29985-29988; evidence 564-570; reporting-work 56 voice links passed readback. Every row and evidence unit explicitly preserves the disputed Ibn Abbas attribution and links the Guezzou published witness plus Arabic Tanwir source. Together with W08, the staged Tanwir group is database-saved and readback verified.
